assertions.name: invalid_prompt_contracts_are_rejected
assertions.detail: Focused tests rejected excess secondary actions, mismatched elapsed evidence, missing uncertainty, coercive language, and asserted intent before persistence.

assertions.name: signed_prompt_is_clear_and_restart_safe
assertions.detail: The signed Today prompt restored once after relaunch with exact minutes, application, task, uncertainty boundary, one primary action, and three secondary actions.

assertions.name: signed_primary_action_routes_once
assertions.detail: Return to the named task activated Ship client proposal and created one answered history row without duplicating the prompt.

assertions.name: limited_coverage_suppresses_intervention
assertions.detail: The live agent stayed silent under missing Screenwatch coverage while Today and Source Health explained the uncertainty and manual fallback.
